Halloween just got a Latinx glow-up. 💀🔥 Noche Latina: Día de los Muertos is landing at Azúcar and it's about to be the only costume party worth leaving the house for. Disfráz required, miedo optional — show up as your favorite calavera, villain, or icon y gana premios toda la noche.

Beer pong takes over the lounge, DJ spinning en la pista, decoraciones de altar everywhere you look. Es gratis, es sábado, es Halloween — there's no excuse to stay home. 🎃🧡

Mark it, tell your gente, round up the squad — this is the one night a year Azúcar turns into pure spectacle. No te la pierdas.

🗓️ Sábado, 31 de octubre • Doors 9PM — partying past daylight savings til 2AM
📍 Azucar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
🎟️ Free / Gratis
🔞 21+

#AzucarPasco #OutAndAbout #NocheLatina #DiaDeLosMuertos #Halloween2026 #CostumeContest #TriCities #PascoWA #LatinxNightlife

Marigolds glowing, skull makeup catching the light, bajo vibrando por todo Azúcar. 🌼💀 Noche Latina: Día de los Muertos is a full sensory trip — sugar skulls painted on faces, sarape colors mixing with Halloween black, y la pista llena antes de que termine la primera canción.

Feel the beer pong balls bouncing in the lounge, the DJ layering beats that keep pulling you back to the dance floor, the energy of a room dressed to impress for a costume contest with prizes dropping all night long. 🎃🏆

This isn't just a party, it's an experience — half ofrenda, half rager, all Azúcar. Ven disfrazado, ven con tu gente, y deja que la noche te lleve.

🗓️ Sábado, 31 de octubre • Puertas 9PM, fiesta hasta las 2AM
📍 Azucar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
🎟️ Gratis
🔞 21+

#AzucarPasco #OutAndAbout #NocheLatina #DiaDeLosMuertos #CalaveraVibes #TriCitiesNightlife #PascoWA #HalloweenParty

Come as you are — or come as una catrina, a zombie, your favorite telenovela villain, whatever speaks to you. 💀🎭 Noche Latina: Día de los Muertos is for everybody who wants to celebrate, dress up, and dance without judgment. This is Azúcar's gente — all colors, all costumes, all welcome.

Se vale venir en pareja, con amigos, solo — lo que importa es que vengas listo pa' la pista. Beer pong con tus amigos en el lounge, DJ manteniendo el ambiente prendido, decoraciones que honran la tradición mientras el Halloween se cuela por todos lados. 🧡🖤

No cover, no excuses — just a night built for the culture to show out in costume and take home some prizes while we're at it. Azúcar is home. Ven como eres, o ven como quien tú quieras ser.

Save the date, mark the calendar, tell your crew — Noche Latina: Día de los Muertos hits Azúcar this Halloween and the details are too good to skip. 🗓️💀

Disfráz required, miedo optional. Costume contest running all night with prizes up for grabs, beer pong set up en el lounge, DJ keeping la pista moving on the main floor, and decoraciones turning the whole spot into a Día de los Muertos dream. Entrada gratis — the only cost is showing up in your best look. 🎃🏆

Doors open 9PM and the party keeps going past daylight savings, straight through to 2AM. Grab your disfráz, grab your people, and get here early — this one fills up fast.
